review_input.original_instruction: You're standing in a living room. On the left you can see a blue sofa with a picture above it. If you turn around you'll see two double doors that are white that are open. Walk through this doorway. You'll be standing in front of two white chairs. To your left you'll see a white sofa, walk towards this white sofa. To your left you'll see a large opening to another room and a white table in the middle. Walk towards this white table. And look towards the left you can see a white bench with some pillows on it, walk towards this bench. And to the left you'll see a door that's open walk towards this door. And to the right you'll see a stairway, go up the first two stairs. Once you're standing on the first two stairs you've reached the end.

subtasks: You are standing in a living room. On the left you can see a blue sofa with a picture above it. If you turn around, you will see two white double doors that are open. Walk through this doorway. You will be standing in front of two white chairs.

Walk towards this white table. Look towards the left. You can see a white bench with some pillows on it; walk towards this bench. To the left you will see an open door; walk towards this door. To the right you will see a stairway; go up the first two stairs. Once you are standing on the first two stairs, you have reached the end.
